baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus repeats the guidance root as attained orientation and then as the object of increase before ending with bestowed taqwa.
baseline_models.mechanism: Initial receptivity starts a positive feedback process: direction already accepted is augmented, then consolidated as an inward capacity to place oneself behind protection.

activation_trace.role: Gentle direction toward a way or truth supplies both the accepted orientation and what is subsequently increased.
Growth entering an existing thing makes the middle clause amplification rather than replacement.
Bestowal marks the final protective capacity as received rather than merely self-generated.
Putting oneself into protection identifies taqwa as an enacted self-guarding disposition.

changed_reading.before: A linear promise that guided people receive more guidance and piety.
changed_reading.after: A recursive formation process in which receptive orientation is amplified until it becomes an endowed capacity for self-protection.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Direction, increase, arrival, and protection can all be read as operations required to continue along a route.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sequence spatializes its recipients as travelers who acquire a bearing, receive reserve for continued movement, gain a traversable approach, and learn protective foot placement on injurious ground.

activation_trace.role: Direction, manner, and intended course turn both guidance occurrences into a maintained bearing.
Travel provision carried for movement recasts the increase as usable reserve for continuation.
A traveled road and alignment supply the approach along which augmented direction can be enacted.
A mount sparing a sore hoof on rough ground turns taqwa into discriminating foot placement.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is an abstract quantity added to cognition.
changed_reading.after: Guidance is operational route capacity: bearing, provisions, access, and protective movement are progressively fitted together.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The giving verb and the possessive form of taqwa allow the final term to be heard as the recipients' fitted endowment.
baseline_models.mechanism: An initial orientation opens a gift cycle in which direction is enlarged and returned as protection suited to its recipients, rather than as an undifferentiated moral commodity.

activation_trace.role: A gentle gift sent toward one held in affinity gives the repeated guidance a relational transfer frame.
Increase scales the transferred good in response to prior orientation.
Explicit giving makes the protective endpoint an endowment delivered to the recipients.
A barrier that repels harm supplies the concrete function of the fitted gift.

changed_reading.before: The final noun names a generic virtue awarded after guidance.
changed_reading.after: The final gift is a recipient-fitted protective endowment that answers and extends an already chosen orientation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening context places guidance inside a contested routing system. Concealment and diversion obstruct a traversable way and make action lose direction, while following can pursue either instability or what holds true; the focus increase therefore acts as repeated counter-routing against active drift.

activation_trace.role: Direction and intended course anchor the changed reading in the focus's doubled guidance.
Growth supplies repeated reinforcement of the chosen course.
Occluding truth provides the perceptual condition under which a route can be missed.
Turning aside and diverting supplies an active force opposed to sustained orientation.
An extended way that is actually traveled gives the routing model its material track.
Deviation from guidance and intended direction supplies the failed trajectory.
Following directly behind makes continued orientation depend on which lead is pursued.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the firm destination of one following path.

structural_cues: 47:1 places path obstruction before the loss of direction in works.
47:3 repeats following on both sides of a false-versus-stable contrast, making route selection rather than mere possession decisive.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, diversion, a traveled way, straying, following, and stable truth; I supply the arrow that repeated guidance counteracts those routing pressures. A live alternative is that the opening only contrasts outcomes and does not describe the focus's internal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: More guidance is a neutral increase in correct information.
changed_reading.after: More guidance is active route reinforcement that keeps an already responsive person from being diverted into a competing track.

context_deltas.mechanism: Trial exposes vulnerability, after which guidance is paired with repair, strengthened feet, the counter-image of stumbling, and travel through the land. The focus sequence can therefore model rehabilitation: support is added until vulnerable movement becomes guarded movement.

activation_trace.role: Walking while leaning on others supplies a surprising image of guidance as supported, still-fragile motion.
Protecting a tender hoof from rough ground converts the endpoint into learned defensive placement.
Testing that makes a condition appear supplies the pressure under which weakness and recovery become visible.
Renewed gentle direction after ordeal connects restoration back to the focus's guidance root.
Repair against corruption turns guidance into restoration of a damaged condition.
Strengthening and fixing supplies the stabilizing operation in the rehabilitation sequence.
The foot that contacts the ground localizes stability as embodied movement.
A fall without recovery gives the surrounding counter-image to supported and protected footing.
Moving onward supplies the practical test of whether restored footing can carry a route.

structural_cues: 47:7 ends with feet, 47:8 supplies a fall, and 47:10 calls for movement through the land.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies trial, repair, stabilization, feet, falling, and travel; I infer that the peripheral assisted-walking and hoof-protection branches form a rehabilitation mechanism. The alternative is that the bodily sequence is only conventional moral metaphor.

changed_reading.before: Increase in guidance indicates steadily greater certainty in an already capable subject.
changed_reading.after: Increase can be repeated support for a vulnerable subject, culminating in the capacity to move without reopening the injury that once destabilized the path.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden and river material activates a cultivation model already latent in increase, conveyed flow, yield, and protection. Receptive orientation behaves like terrain that admits a current; guidance grows through that inflow, while taqwa functions like regulation that preserves the current until it bears clean fruit.

activation_trace.role: Organic increase supplies the growth process to be fed by the contextual currents.
A watercourse and the clearing of its passage turn bestowal into conveyed flow.
Emergent crop and fruit yield give the conveyed guidance a productive endpoint.
A barrier against damage supplies the regulating edge that preserves growth.
Unimpeded running and spreading provide the kinetic behavior of the incoming benefit.
A river cutting earth with running water supplies a channel formed through receptive ground.
Self-placement in protection explicitly associates the garden comparison with practiced guarding.
Water as the material itself fills out the otherwise abstract flow analogy.
Purity from admixture makes protection a quality-preserving operation rather than mere enclosure.
Mature fruit supplies the visible yield of successfully sustained growth.

structural_cues: 47:12 and 47:15 repeat gardens and rivers before and near the focus.
The focus orders increase, conveyance, and protection in the same causal order that an irrigation reading requires.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies running water, channels, practiced protection, purity, and fruit; I supply the arrow that these material relations model the focus's spiritual growth. The live alternative is that the river catalog remains an eschatological contrast without explaining 47:17.

changed_reading.before: Guidance grows by an unspecified inward addition.
changed_reading.after: Guidance can be imagined as irrigated cultivation: an admitted flow increases life, and taqwa regulates and preserves that increase until it yields.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding scene separates acoustic exposure from comprehension and compliance: some listen yet leave asking what was just said, while knowledge is bestowed elsewhere and sealed hearts follow inclination. The focus then describes the successful alternative, in which received direction is retained, amplified, and converted into guarding.

activation_trace.role: Gentle indication accepted as direction anchors successful uptake in the focus.
Growth marks what happens when the heard indication is retained rather than lost.
Practiced self-guarding is the durable disposition produced by successful uptake.
Bare auditory perception supplies the low-retention mode displayed immediately before the focus.
Understanding that issues in compliance supplies the unrealized higher mode against which bare hearing is measured.
Bestowed knowledge parallels the focus's bestowed taqwa and links reception to differentiated outcomes.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the content that some recipients can retain and others fail to integrate.
A sealing imprint supplies the closure that prevents heard material from becoming living orientation.
The heart localizes the receiving and retaining faculty on which the contrast turns.
Following directly behind supplies the behavioral output of whichever inward signal dominates.
Inward inclination supplies the rival attractor that unguarded hearing follows.

structural_cues: 47:16 and 47:17 are adjacent contrastive relative clauses about two kinds of recipients.
The bestowal of knowledge in 47:16 is answered by the bestowal of taqwa in 47:17.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hearing, a comprehension-and-compliance branch, bestowed knowledge, sealed hearts, and following inclination; I infer that the focus's increase is successful transduction from exposure into durable orientation. The alternative is a simpler contrast of groups without a cognitive uptake mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Those already classified as guided are simply awarded a larger amount of guidance.
changed_reading.after: The guided are those in whom exposure remains active: hearing becomes orientation, orientation compounds, and the result is resistance to sealing and rival inclination.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following ayah turns arrival into a temporal problem: a sudden event approaches, its preliminaries have already appeared, and reminder may come too late. This activates the focus's access-and-readiness branch so that increased guidance equips recipients before the abrupt arrival rather than merely rewarding them afterward.

activation_trace.role: Approaching an affair by its proper side and becoming ready for it turns bestowal into timely preparation.
A barrier against harm supplies the preparedness that must exist before impact.
Arrival of an expected event activates the temporal side of the same root used for bestowal in the focus.
Sudden surprise supplies the deadline that makes prior formation necessary.
Repeated coming makes arrival, not abstract futurity, the pressure on remembrance.
Preliminary signs supply an advance interval in which guidance can become readiness.
A reminder that prompts recollection supplies what loses force if deferred until arrival.

structural_cues: The focus is followed immediately by a question about waiting for a sudden arrival.
The same arrival root shifts from bestowal in 47:17 to an event coming upon recipients in 47:18.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies arrival, surprise, precursors, and reminder; I infer that the focus's increase moves preparation earlier than the crisis. A live alternative is that the focus verb is only causative giving and the adjacent arrival language does not alter it.

changed_reading.before: Taqwa is a possession awarded at the end of a completed guidance sequence.
changed_reading.after: Taqwa is readiness furnished in advance, while guidance still has time to convert warning signs into protection before sudden arrival.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later context shows that guidance can become clear and still be reversed: deliberation is blocked, hearts are locked, people turn onto their backs, inward embellishment makes regression attractive, and delay extends it. Taqwa therefore becomes a retention mechanism that protects an acquired trajectory from decay and reversal.

activation_trace.role: Accepted direction anchors the trajectory whose persistence is at issue.
Increase deepens the trajectory so that it can resist later loss rather than remain a single exposure.
Protective separation from harm supplies the retention function assigned to taqwa.
Considering an affair through its consequences supplies the reflective process that should keep direction live.
Closure and hardening block the reflective process from reaching the heart.
Returning something toward its former place supplies direct reversal of an attained course.
The back of a thing makes regression spatially visible as movement opposite the prior orientation.
Manifest clarity removes lack of evidence as the cause of reversal.
Guidance already made available directly links the later regression to the focus's central root.
Internal embellishment makes the backward option feel desirable rather than merely imposed.
Extended time allows attractive regression to persist and consolidate.

structural_cues: 47:24 moves from deliberation to locked hearts, then 47:25 immediately depicts backward movement.
47:25 explicitly places reversal after guidance has become clear.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies blocked reflection, closure, backward return after clarity, internal embellishment, and extension in time; I infer that the focus's increase and taqwa preserve gains against reversal. The alternative is that the later passage describes a separate group without specifying the function of taqwa.

changed_reading.before: Once guidance has been received, increase merely adds further content to a secure state.
changed_reading.after: Increase deepens retention, and taqwa protects already clear guidance from being made attractive in reverse and eroded over time.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guidance is moved from reception into performance. Obedience, resolved intention, truthful fulfillment, exertion, and restraint meet tests that disclose condition; the warning not to cancel intentional work makes taqwa the control by which a professed direction survives decisive action.

activation_trace.role: An intended course and manner anchor guidance as a pattern to be enacted rather than only known.
Growth permits repeated trials to strengthen the enacted pattern.
Self-guarding supplies the behavioral control that keeps commitment intact under demand.
Compliance supplies the first observable conversion of orientation into conduct.
The heart's binding decision supplies the transition from agreeable speech to committed action.
Fulfilling a promise in action supplies the criterion by which verbal orientation becomes real.
Repeated testing that makes condition appear supplies the feedback event in the growth process.
Exerting full capacity under difficulty gives testing a costly behavioral medium.
Restraining the self from panic supplies persistence through the test rather than a momentary response.
Knowledge of reports and inward reality supplies the test's inspectable result.
Cancellation supplies the failure mode against which protective conduct preserves prior work.
Intentional action is the accumulated output that enacted guidance must keep from nullification.

structural_cues: 47:20 moves from requesting a directive to recoil when a decisive directive arrives; 47:21 answers with obedience and resolved truthfulness.
47:31 repeats testing around knowledge of striving, restraint, and reports; 47:33 joins obedience to non-nullification of works.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies obedience, heart-resolution, fulfilled action, testing, exertion, restraint, inspectable reports, and cancellation; I infer that trials can strengthen guidance into protective habit. A live alternative is that trials only reveal a fixed prior state rather than contributing to its increase.

changed_reading.before: The increase is primarily epistemic and taqwa is a settled inner trait.
changed_reading.after: Guidance grows through costly enactment and feedback, while taqwa is the control that carries resolved orientation through pressure without canceling its work.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context shifts from hidden dispositions to their emergence as visible signs, recognizable marks, and inflections of speech, then to testing that exposes reports and inward reality. Increased guidance can therefore include sharpened discernment, while taqwa guards by detecting latent tendencies before they govern conduct.

activation_trace.role: Gentle indication and clarification anchor discernment in the focus's guidance rather than in an independent theme.
Practiced guarding supplies the use to which early diagnostic perception is put.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the transition from latent condition to observable evidence.
Causing something to be seen supplies deliberate disclosure of what was previously hidden.
Recognition by trace or sign supplies the inferential skill activated by disclosure.
A visible marker from which condition is inferred supplies diagnostic evidence rather than direct confession.
The slant of speech toward an implied meaning makes tone a carrier of latent state.
Testing that manifests condition supplies a controlled reveal rather than passive observation.
Uncovering a thing to a knower supplies the epistemic result of the test.
Knowledge of report and interior reality supplies the deeper layer disclosed by outward evidence.

structural_cues: The uncatalogued root ض غ ن recurs in 47:29 and 47:37 as something brought out; it is used here only as a structural reveal cue.
47:30 moves from showing to recognizing a mark and then recognizing an inflection of speech; 47:31 follows with repeated testing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies emergence from concealment, showing, marks, tonal implication, testing, and inner knowledge; I infer that increased guidance can train diagnostic self-monitoring as well as recognition of others. The alternative is that this discernment belongs only to the addressed messenger and does not characterize the recipients in 47:17.

changed_reading.before: More guidance means having more explicit propositions available.
changed_reading.after: More guidance can mean finer sensitivity to weak signals of a latent disposition, with taqwa using that early detection to keep the disposition from taking control.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus gives taqwa as an outcome, while 47:36 reverses the order: practiced taqwa conditions a further giving of recompense. Non-deprivation of work and the later contrast between spending and stinginess extend this into a recursive economy in which received protection is exercised and opens further receipt.

activation_trace.role: Increase anchors the repeated-cycle reading in the focus rather than in later economic material alone.
Giving places taqwa on the received side of the first movement in the cycle.
Practiced self-protection lets the received endowment become an active condition in the next movement.
Loss that strips a right or work supplies the deprivation explicitly denied before the reciprocal sequence.
Enacted guarding now appears before giving, reversing the focus's gift-to-guard order.
A further bestowal follows practiced guarding and closes the second half of the feedback cycle.
Recompense for work gives the second bestowal an enacted rather than purely possessive basis.
Resources leaving in expenditure supply outward circulation of what has been received.
Stinginess supplies the closure that interrupts circulation and exposes the recipient's unresolved guard.
The self or very same entity identifies where withheld circulation ultimately returns as harm.

structural_cues: 47:17 orders giving before taqwa, whereas 47:36 orders taqwa before a further giving.
47:35 denies loss of work, and 47:38 tests the cycle through outward expenditure versus repeated stinginess.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the reversed root order, recompense, non-deprivation, spending, stinginess, and self-effect; I infer a recursive gift economy in which endowed taqwa is exercised and becomes a condition for further giving. The alternative is two independent promises with no feedback relation.

changed_reading.before: Taqwa is the terminal reward in a one-way sequence of divine gifts.
changed_reading.after: Taqwa is both bestowed product and exercised condition: it enters a feedback cycle of reception, guarded action, outward release, and further bestowal.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the cultic-offering branch of the guidance root and risks making the recipients themselves into an offering, which the syntax does not state. It remains anchored in the focus's repeated guidance, increase, giving, and protection, with contextual release and expenditure sustaining a noncommercial transfer pattern. Render it only as an analogical economy of consecrated return, never as the lexical translation of the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The offering branch of the repeated guidance root meets the focus's explicit increase, giving, and protective endpoint.

activation_trace.role: An offering conveyed toward sacred precincts supplies the consecrated-transfer image.
Increase prevents the transfer from ending in depletion and makes it return enlarged.
Giving supplies the return movement by which consecrated orientation becomes protection.
Protection against damage supplies the form in which the returned good benefits its recipients.
Release without compensation supplies a transfer that is not reducible to exchange price.
One thing given on behalf of another supplies the substitution logic of costly release.
Expenditure supplies the later outward motion that keeps the transfer pattern circulating.

changed_reading.before: The recipients keep an internally accumulated stock of guidance.
changed_reading.after: Their accepted orientation can be carried as an offering-like commitment and returned, enlarged, as protective capacity rather than retained as private stock.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it combines a fixed-weight branch of protection with tribute, accounting, wages, and wealth; it should not turn taqwa into a literal monetary quantity. It remains anchored in the focus's scalar increase, possessive endpoint, and bestowal, while later accounting language makes a fitted allotment conceivable. Render it as a cautious calibration analogy: each recipient is furnished with an answerable measure of protection.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The scalar increase and possessive taqwa allow a measured-allotment reading when the weight and assessed-transfer branches are activated.

activation_trace.role: Scalar increase supplies the possibility of a calibrated rather than merely binary endowment.
An assessed due that is handed over supplies the outlier's allotment and accountability frame.
A known unit of weight gives the possessive protective endpoint a deliberately measured image.
Counting and reckoning supply the contextual operation by which an allotment could be calibrated.
Recompense for work supplies an answerable relation between enacted capacity and further receipt.
Possessed wealth makes the nearby accounting register explicit without defining the focus term literally.
Need and limited means keep the fitted measure recipient-relative rather than uniform.

changed_reading.before: Taqwa is bestowed as the same undifferentiated quality on every guided recipient.
changed_reading.after: Taqwa may be imagined as a fitted measure of protective responsibility, increased and allotted in relation to the recipient's enacted capacity and need.

strongest_changes: The 47:16 contrast changes increase from a reward for a fixed class into successful conversion of hearing into retained, guarded orientation.
The lock-and-reversal sequence in 47:24-25 changes taqwa into protection of already clear guidance against attractive regression and delay.
The reversed order of guarding and giving in 47:36 makes taqwa both an endowed result and an enacted condition for further bestowal.
The reveal-and-test sequence in 47:29-31 activates increased guidance as sensitivity to latent states, not only possession of explicit propositions.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's repeated guidance root and its increase-to-giving-to-protection sequence remained live across competing route, rehabilitation, cultivation, receptivity, temporal, diagnostic, performative, and reciprocal mechanisms instead of collapsing into one moral gloss.
remaining_uncertainties: The giver is implicit inside the focus; these models assume continuity with divine agency supplied by the surrounding context.
The route, assisted-gait, irrigation, offering, and calibrated-allotment readings use peripheral or split-root branches and should remain analogical rather than lexical claims.
It remains live whether testing contributes to increased guidance or only reveals a condition already formed.
The possessive ending on taqwa may signal appropriation or fitness without requiring the stronger claim of individualized calibration.
